fact_dispositions.subject: main/melee/lb/lb_0219:.sbss
fact_dispositions.prior_value: Provides zero-initialized persistent globals for the asset-driven flash manager: an RGB intensity scale, the loaded flash color-animation table pointer, and the manager GObj pointer used to access its embedded ColorOverlay state.
fact_dispositions.reason: Canonical initialization and consumers support current claim; full-screen interpretation is attested by file purpose, not independently reviewed renderer implementation.

evidence.why: Declarations and allocation-guarded initialization establish persistent state.
RGB multiplier and separate alpha coefficient produce submitted flash color.
Reset and animation start consume stored GObj and loaded animation table.

fact_dispositions.subject: main/melee/lb/lb_0219:.sbss
fact_dispositions.prior_value: A 16-byte uninitialized small-data block beginning at 0x804D63D8. Its identified layout is an f32 RGB scale at +0x0, a pointer receiving lbBgFlashColAnimData at +0x4, and a pointer to the animated-flash manager GObj at +0x8; the final four bytes at +0xC remain unidentified or may be section padding.
fact_dispositions.reason: Narrow layout claim to recovered source declarations; final padding and exact section size have not been verified from linker evidence.

fact_dispositions.subject: main/melee/lb/lb_0219:.sbss
fact_dispositions.prior_value: The identified words begin zeroed with the .sbss block. Successful manager initialization replaces the null object and animation-data pointers and sets the RGB scale to 1.0; failed GObj or user-data allocation returns before publishing those values. Thereafter the pointers remain persistent manager state, while the scale is mutable and affects enabled animation updates.
fact_dispositions.reason: Canonical initialization and consumers support current claim; full-screen interpretation is attested by file purpose, not independently reviewed renderer implementation.
